title: The First Wake · The Geometry of Becoming

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The scale changes, but Rill’s curiosity and its bonds give the reader continuity.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Technical questions become questions about whose experience a rule can recognize.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The later discoveries, reversals, and final choices belong to the reading itself.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: What this introduction can show is how the book makes those discoveries worth following.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: This is philosophical science fiction for readers interested in consciousness, identity, and the experience of time.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Its unfamiliar vocabulary asks for attention, and the text provides conceptual guidance along the way.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: You can follow Rill’s desire to explore and Skein’s caution before mastering their world.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The reward is a way to imagine minds whose lives resist our usual assumptions.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Their humour and attachments keep those differences connected to recognizable emotional stakes.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: You may leave a scene with a better question rather than a settled answer.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: That openness is part of the reading experience the novel asks you to enter.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Return to Rill’s game, where an apparently impossible dependency interrupts a familiar routine.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: What begins as curiosity soon tests how a world describes the lives inside it.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The First Wake offers a story in which measurement, identity, and affection keep affecting one another.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Its larger answers require the encounters and choices that this introduction has deliberately left open.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Start with the translator’s note, then follow the prologue into the Playfield.
